message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: The defendant Ye made forged company seals (company stamps) for two companies: Pingyu Yongsheng Leather Co., Ltd. and Lixin County Rujie Town Leather Co., Ltd. He forged company seals, financial stamps, legal representative stamps. He was caught. So the crime is forging company, enterprise, institution seals: 伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章. Also possibly "伪造印章" is the offense. The correction rules: If the facts describe creation or use of forged company/enterprise/organization seal to impersonate that entity and obtain money, charge the offense of 伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章 rather than contr. So we should list that offense. Also maybe "伪造印章" is the same. The rule says: When listing the crime name(s) between the [罪名] and <eoa> tags, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章". No "罪". If multiple offenses, separate with semicolon. Here only one offense. So final answer: [罪名]伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章<eoa>.
